notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware was attached and no hardware or sim backend was run. The card's decision and helper (family-config, MujocoDriver) express the served interface: the package serves the card's first model, conda/robotiq_gripper_85.xml (models[0]), as a simulated R0 world.sim. The card's entry symbol environment.tabletop_env:TabletopEnv was verified at environment/tabletop_env.py:20 (ast confidence), but it is the robosuite environment that uses this gripper, not the MJCF the MuJoCo family loads; the family names no native class, so the package has no native attribute. The decision and helper were not changed, so there is no DEVIATION FROM THE CARD; the entry symbol is simply not used as native. The step action is data.ctrl, bounded per actuator by the model's actuator_ctrlrange (two position actuators, ctrlrange 0 to 0.85); cap.world.reset.v1 restores the model defaults; the world state is the integration state plus the tick. MuJoCo was not installed and cannot be installed where the gate ran (no network, no pip), so the fake backend (fake.py) is a stand-in mujoco module: it parses the MJCF for the six joints, the two actuators and their control ranges, but integrates a placeholder first-order motion and resolves no mesh, contact, equality or tendon constraint. The model's <asset> block names STL meshes under meshes/robotiq_85_gripper/ that are not present in the clone, so the real mujoco backend would need an installed robosuite asset tree; the fake needs none of them. No trajectory was compared with the real engine and the sim path (a backend that backends does not name, which imports mujoco) was not run. Expected warnings: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND (the simulator family treats the injected stand-in module as the upstream simulator, so native calls are not recorded and G7 has no fake surface to check; the fake is not the upstream simulator) and G8.NO_UNIT x3 (the bridge-derived inputs seed, ticks and action.ctrl; action.ctrl is in the model's actuator units). No catalogue requests: only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are used. There are no operator-required limits, so no site-limits.example.json is needed. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
